documented_evidence: The 1968 flood mark is lower than the undated higher mark.
A 1972 ledger records stone coping replacement along part of North Quay.
A 1974 public map depicts a slightly altered quay edge.
knowledge.discoveries.preferred_interpretation: The 1972 coping work likely contributed to an altered or raised section.
limits: The exact raising year is unresolved.
It is unresolved whether the higher mark came from the same work campaign.
The evidence does not establish that the whole quay was raised in 1972.

north_quay.rebuild_hypotheses.hypothesis: The 1972 coping work likely contributed to an altered or raised section later represented by the higher flood mark and the 1974 map.
confidence_basis: The 1972 work is the only dated work record.
The later physical and mapped conditions align with that limited work.
uncertainties: The ledger covers only part of North Quay.
The relationship between the mark and the ledger work is unproven.

threads.resolved: North Quay exhibit claim corrected to evidence-supported wording
threads.open: Exact raising year and relationship between the higher mark and the 1972 work remain unresolved
